The Things I Use for Things
July 2026

  • Scott Blue Shop Towels

    Way tougher than your standard paper towel. Maybe not as good for spills, but great for shop or garage work.

  • Windshield Cleaning Tool and Armor All Glass Cleaner.

    Absolutely perfect duo for a quick, quality wash of the inside of your car's windshield. (I have a slightly different tool with a shorter handle. This one is the one I'd get if I had to buy it again.)

The Armor All Glass Cleaner used to be called something like Auto Glass Cleaner. I'm assuming they dropped that name for the more generic Glass Cleaner when they started putting the labeling on it that it's safe for tech screen. I'm not sure what the difference between this cleaner and regular Windex, but it sure seems to work better for the inside of my windshield.
